# Flames

> _Not to be confused with the flame trail produced by [Fire Ants](/wiki/Fire_Ant "Fire Ant")._

**Flames** are objects that can be generated by certain [Tools](/wiki/Tools "Tools"), [Ability Tokens](/wiki/Ability_Tokens "Ability Tokens"), or [Passive Abilities](/wiki/Passive_Abilities "Passive Abilities"). Flames have a percentage chance to spawn when bees gather, lasting for 4 seconds.

### Core Mechanics
Each second, flames perform the following actions:
*   **Pollen Collection:** Collects 5 red, 3 white, or 2 blue [pollen](/wiki/Pollen "Pollen") from 9 surrounding flowers. This collection rate is modified by bonuses (+2% per red bee and +4% per gifted red bee if spawned by the player; +10% per bee level if spawned by a bee).
*   **Damage:** Deals 10 + (25% of [base Bee Attack](/wiki/Bee_Attack "Bee Attack")) damage per second to any mob (15 damage if spawned by the player).
*   **Buffs:** Grants the player [flame heat](/wiki/Buffs_%26_Debuffs#From_Passives "Buffs & Debuffs").

Flames can be generated by:
*   The [Scythe](/wiki/Scythe "Scythe")
*   [Fire Bee](/wiki/Fire_Bee "Fire Bee"), [Demon Bee](/wiki/Demon_Bee "Demon Bee"), or [Spicy Bee's](/wiki/Spicy_Bee "Spicy Bee")
*   The [Inferno](/wiki/Ability_Tokens#Inferno "Ability Tokens") ability token
*   Bees equipped with the ![Bead Lizard](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)[Bead Lizard](/wiki/Bead_Lizard "Bead Lizard") or ![Electric Candle](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)[Electric Candle](/wiki/Electric_Candle "Electric Candle") beequips
*   The Ignite passive from the [Fire Mask](/wiki/Fire_Mask "Fire Mask")
*   The X-Flame passive from the [Demon Mask](/wiki/Demon_Mask "Demon Mask")

Flames are also used to help grow Scorching Stars.

## Flame Heat
**Flame Heat** is a buff granted by flames, providing extra Red Pollen and Bee Attack. It starts at x1.2 [Red Pollen](/wiki/System_Page#Red_Pollen "System Page") and grants +5% [Bee Attack](/wiki/Bee_Attack "Bee Attack") Multiplier.

The Flame Heat grows faster the more flames are around the player, reaching a maximum of 20 seconds at x2 Red Pollen and +25% Bee Attack Multiplier. This buff boosts [Spicy Bee's](/wiki/Spicy_Bee "Spicy Bee") Movespeed and gather speed, and can be consumed by [Precise Bee](/wiki/Precise_Bee "Precise Bee") to convert Pollen into Honey.

## Gathering Flames
The **Gathering Flames** passive increases the chance for a bee to spawn a flame while gathering pollen from a field.

*   Fire Bees have a 35% base chance (50% if gifted) for their Gathering Flames passive to spawn a flame.
*   Demon Bees have a 65% base chance (85% if gifted) for their Gathering Flames+ passive to spawn a flame.

This passive chance can be increased via bee equips:
*   **Bead Lizard:** Increases the Gathering Flames chance from +9% to +14%.
*   **Electric Candle:** Increases the Gathering Flames chance from +1% to +5%. Using waxes can increase this amount up to +25%.

## Dark Flames
When flames are hit with a [Dark Scythe](/wiki/Dark_Scythe "Dark Scythe"), they convert into **dark flames**. These dark violet flames have enhanced properties:
*   They collect pollen from 13 surrounding flowers (instead of 9).
*   They deal 50% more damage.
*   They grant both Dark Heat and normal Flame Heat.
*   They provide an additional 33% growth boost to Scorching Stars.

## Flame Stats & Modifiers

### Flame Pollen
**Flame Pollen** is the amount of pollen that flames can collect, viewable in the system page. It can be increased through various methods:

*   **Demon Mask:** Provides a x1.25 Flame Pollen multiplier.
*   **Gifted Fire Bee:** Provides a x1.25 Flame Pollen multiplier.
*   **Beequips:**
    *   **Electric Candle (Individual):** Grants +5% to +10% Flame Pollen. Using waxes can increase this up to 50%.
    *   **Electric Candle (Hive Bonus):** Grants +1% Flame Pollen, which can be increased up to 11% using waxes.
*   **Cog Amulets:**
    *   Silver Cog Amulet: Up to +5% Flame Pollen.
    *   Gold Cog Amulet: Up to +8% Flame Pollen.
    *   Diamond Cog Amulet: From +12% up to +14% Flame Pollen.
    *   Supreme Cog Amulet: From +15% up to +20% Flame Pollen.
*   **Stickers:**
    *   Small Flame Bee Sticker: +3% Flame Pollen.
    *   Dark Flame Sticker: +3% Flame Pollen.
    *   Orange Swirled Marble Sticker: +3% Flame Pollen.
*   **Robo Bear Challenge (Epic Upgrades):**
    *   Furnace: Grants a x1.5 Flame Pollen multiplier.

### Flame Duration
**Flame Duration** determines how long flames last. It can be increased by:
*   Spicy Bee's gifted bonus (+25% more time).
*   Gifted Spicy Bee's [Flame Fuel](/wiki/Ability_Tokens#Flame_Fuel "Ability Tokens") ability (+50% more time).

Note that Flame Fuel also causes the flames to instantly convert 50,000 pollen plus 10% (+5% per Field Boost) of the hive's total convert amount.

### Instant Flame Conversion
**Instant Flame Conversion** dictates how much collected pollen is instantly converted. It can be increased by:
*   Fire Mask: +50% Instant Flame Conversion.
*   Demon Mask: +50% Instant Flame Conversion.
*   Scorching Star: +50% Instant Flame Conversion.

### Other Improvements (Robo Bear Challenge)
Certain Robo Bear Challenge upgrades can further improve flames:
*   **Furnace:** Grants x1.5 Flame Duration and x1.5 Flame Damage.
*   **Invert:** Makes flames collect 4x pollen from blue flowers.

### Trivia
*   The maximum Flame Pollen a player can achieve is approximately 380%. This requires combining bonuses such as the Demon Mask (x1.25), Gifted Fire Bee (x1.25), Supreme Cog Amulet (+20%), multiple Electric Candles, Sticker Stack activation (+9%), and the Furnace upgrade (x1.5).
*   The maximum Instant Flame Conversion a player can achieve is 100%, typically by having either the Fire Mask or Demon Mask (+50%) alongside a Scorching Star (+50%).
*   Flames generated by another player's bees appear dark red instead of yellow-orange.
*   Flames are considered the counterpart to [Bubbles](/wiki/Bubble "Bubble").
